ISRIC advises against using SoilGrids for local/farm-level decisions. These values supply regional background and do not replace a soil test.
SoilGrids has no single observation year. Retrieval time is not a soil sampling date. The API does not identify a measurement date for this point.
The 0–5 cm layer does not describe the whole root zone, drainage, salinity, nutrients, management or irrigation capacity.
Prediction intervals are supplied by the soil model, not invented crop-confidence percentages. Regional estimates are never auto-filled as measured farm inputs.

Sources: ISRIC SoilGrids · Poggio et al. (2021)
water:
Published irrigation history
Historical national totals describe reported irrigation practice, not this farm’s water requirement or present water availability.
These are broad crop categories, not crop-specific schedules. The ratio is annual water applied per irrigated hectare, not a recommended dose.
The 2020–21 Water Use on Australian Farms series has ceased. Newer Water Account releases exist but are not substituted into this matched crop/area calculation.
Do not divide this annual average into daily irrigation or multiply it into an expected water-saving claim. Weather, planting dates, soil, efficiency and irrigation method differ.
